result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but one image in the 'Popular right now' section appears to be stuck in a loading state, showing a spinner overlay instead of the finished photo.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image displays a circular loading spinner overlay in the center, indicating the image never finished loading or the loading state was never dismissed. The underlying photo is visible but the spinner remains on top.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image loading state resolves correctly: hide the spinner once the image loads, and add a timeout/fallback (e.g., show the image or a placeholder) so the spinner does not persist indefinitely.
